method: v9: validated multi-scale census->result ridge (all 88 attrs) gives geographic shape; 2-point calibration to the LucidTalk unity poll (community rates + NI level); poststratified per Data Zone weighted by eligible electorate x census-fitted turnout (not resident population). ni_level is the turnout-adjusted result; resident_wtd is the old all-resident read, kept for comparison. Poll dates post-2021-Census -> 2021 attrs.
